lines.text: The high priest asks Stephen if the charges are true, and Stephen says God appeared to Abraham in Mesopotamia.
Abraham leaves the land of the Chaldeans, God promises him the land though he has no child, and gives the covenant of circumcision.
The patriarchs sell Joseph into Egypt because they are jealous, and Pharaoh makes him chief baker of his palace.

wrong_details.true: ruler over Egypt and all his household

lines.text: A new king oppresses Israel's people, Pharaoh's daughter raises Moses, and after he strikes down an Egyptian, Moses flees to Moab.
An angel appears to Moses in a burning bush near Mount Sinai, and later the people make a calf while Moses is away.
